lines.japanese: 気がつくと、俺は軽く眠っていたらしい。
lines.english: When I came to, I seemed to have dozed off.

lines.japanese: 浅い睡眠から目覚めて、ゆっくりと起き上がる。おいっちにー、さんしー。よし、体はよく動く。
lines.english: I surfaced from shallow sleep and slowly sat up. One-two, three-four. Good. Everything still worked.

lines.japanese: 公園の出口に向かい、風見が丘に向けてゆっくり歩いていく。
lines.english: I made for the park exit and began the slow walk toward Kazamigaoka.

lines.japanese: 帰る道すがら、今日のことを色々と考えてみた。
lines.english: On the way home, I turned the day's events over in my mind.

lines.japanese: 結局、大司教は今回の件とは関係なかった。
lines.english: In the end, the Archbishop had nothing to do with what had happened.

lines.japanese: あの気の違ったやつに計画的な行動がとれるはずがないし、そもそもやつは小鳩のことすら知らなかった。
lines.english: That lunatic couldn't have carried out anything so deliberate. More to the point, he hadn't even known who Kobato was.

lines.japanese: となると、誰かが俺を嵌めていたことになる。そうじゃないと、あまりにことが上手く進みすぎている。
lines.english: Which meant somebody had set me up. Otherwise, everything had fallen into place far too neatly.

lines.japanese: そういえば、森里は無事に病院に運ばれただろうか。
lines.english: Come to think of it, had Morisato gotten to the hospital safely?

lines.japanese: そして、亜衣は家に帰れただろうか。
lines.english: And had Ai made it home?

lines.japanese: 亜衣に連絡でもとってみようかとも思ったが、俺はやつの携帯の番号すら知らないので、それは諦めた。
lines.english: I thought of contacting Ai, but I didn't even know her phone number. So much for that.

lines.japanese: ガード下に戻ってみようかという気にもなりかけたが、おそらく無駄足だ。もう何一つ残っちゃいないだろう。下手すりゃ、現場検証中の警察と鉢合わせて、面倒なことになりかねない。
lines.english: I nearly went back beneath the tracks, but it would probably have been a wasted trip. Nothing would be left by now. With my luck, I'd walk straight into the police combing over the scene and buy myself a whole new mess.

lines.japanese: 俺は羽田家の前まで辿り着いた。明かりはもちろんついてない。
lines.english: I reached the Haneda house. Naturally, not a light was on.

lines.japanese: これから先にも、今日みたいなことがあるんだろうか。
lines.english: Was this kind of thing going to keep happening?

lines.japanese: ふと、そんな焦燥感にとらわれ、家に入ることが躊躇われた。
lines.english: A sudden anxiety took hold of me, and I hesitated at the door.

lines.japanese: 小鳩の部屋を覗くと、穏やかな表情で眠りについている。
lines.english: I looked into Kobato's room. She was sleeping peacefully.

lines.japanese: 俺は今日の出来事とのあまりに対照的な寝顔に、少し噴き出しかけた。
lines.english: Her sleeping face stood in such stark contrast to the day I’d had that I almost laughed.

lines.japanese: 扉を閉めて、タカシの部屋へと入る。
lines.english: I closed the door and went into Takashi's room.

lines.japanese: そろそろ、引き際なのかもしれねえな。
lines.english: Maybe it was about time to bow out.

lines.japanese: 俺は横たえた体の節々から湧き上がる痛みを感じながら、そんなことを思った。
lines.english: That was what I thought as I lay there, pain rising from every joint.
